pub assume_specification<Key, Value, A: Allocator + Clone, Q: ?Sized + Ord>[ BTreeMap::<Key, Value, A>::split_off::<Q> ](
    m: &mut BTreeMap<Key, Value, A>,
    key: &Q,
) -> (result: BTreeMap<Key, Value, A>)
    where
        Key: Borrow<Q> + Ord,
        A: Clone,
    requires
        obeys_cmp::<Key>(),
    ensures
        old(m)@ == final(m)@.union_prefer_right(result@),
        final(m)@.dom().disjoint(result@.dom()),
        !contains_borrowed_key(final(m)@, key),
        contains_borrowed_key(result@, key) == contains_borrowed_key(old(m)@, key),
        forall|left_key: Key, right_key: Key|
            final(m)@.contains_key(left_key) && result@.contains_key(right_key)
                ==> left_key.cmp_spec(&right_key) == core::cmp::Ordering::Less,
;
ensures: old(m)@ == final(m)@.union_prefer_right(result@)
final(m)@.dom().disjoint(result@.dom())

contains_borrowed_key(result@, key) == contains_borrowed_key(old(m)@, key)
forall|left_key: Key, right_key: Key| final(m)@.contains_key(left_key) && result@.contains_key(right_key) ==> left_key.cmp_spec(&right_key) == core::cmp::Ordering::Less

Borrowed-key facts rely on the opaque contains_borrowed_key model and standard Borrow/Ord consistency; allocator state is not modeled.

pub assume_specification<T: Ord, A: Allocator + Clone>[ BTreeSet::<T, A>::is_subset ](
    this: &BTreeSet<T, A>,
    other: &BTreeSet<T, A>,
) -> (result: bool)
    requires
        obeys_cmp::<T>(),
    ensures
        result == this@.subset_of(other@),
;
ensures: result == this@.subset_of(other@)
candidate.rationale: The documentation defines the result as whether every element of self occurs in other, exactly matching Set::subset_of. The implementation performs equivalent ordered membership checks without mutation; obeys_cmp::<T>() supplies the ordering law needed by the BTreeSet view.
risks: Callers must establish obeys_cmp::<T>().
No no_unwind guarantee is claimed because a user-defined Ord::cmp may panic.

ensures: result == this@.subset_of(other@)
